record.body:
## Rationale

Amendment signing already uses ssh-keygen and allowed_signers. Reusing that stack keeps one trust root and makes a merge gate verify bytes, not an agent-printed pass line.

## Counter-argument

Sigstore/OIDC would bind CI identity without managing deploy keys. It adds a new dependency and does not reuse the amendment allowlist the repo already ships.

payload.alternatives: Sigstore/OIDC identity; unsigned local advisory with CI-only gate
payload.choice: SSH-sign a canonical verdict attestation (namespace affidavit-verdict) bound to commit, manifest hash, runner digest, and per-claim results; verify rejects tamper and wrong binds

record.subject: verdict-attestation
